demos.name: MCP Auth Conformance LAB
demos.description: Score a mock MCP server with selectable defects (or, in Live mode, a gated read-only probe of one URL you type) against the MCP authorization expectations, with a sourced reference of what ChatGPT and other clients need.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 4901). Docker: docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1:4901 only; the Live probe stays loopback-only in the container). Mock is the default and needs no tenant or credentials.
